_comment: Plugin configuration for the Credit 360 cockpit. ONE COCKPIT PER ORGANIZATION, RESOLVED PER VIEWER: this page declares runtime capabilities (connectors and a store), and a capability-declaring artifact can be shared inside its own claude.ai organization and never by public link, so `canonicalArtifactUrl` opens only for seats in the organization it was published from and answers 'artifact not found' everywhere else. It is therefore a FALLBACK, not a promise. The skill's open resolves in order: (1) the URL this session's own Artifact publish returned; (2) the most recently updated artifact titled 'Credit 360 · Relationship Cockpit' (or the older 'Customer 360 · Relationship Cockpit') that the viewer owns or is shared, found with Artifact action:'list' scope:'all' and verified with action:'read'; (3) this canonicalArtifactUrl, and only if action:'read' succeeds for it; (4) otherwise publish the bundled template as a new artifact and tell the viewer they can share it to their organization from the page's Share control. Steps 1 to 3 are one listing call and one read: no fetch, no assembler, no publish. Change this value only when the canonical cockpit is republished to a new URL. Never put a passcode, token or secret in this file.
